effects: Signing lets anyone submit castVoteBySig, which casts the signer's vote on proposalId with the chosen support: 0 = Against, 1 = For, 2 = Abstain (GovernorCountingSimple._countVote).
The vote uses the signer's full HOP voting power at the proposal snapshot (getVotes in Governor._castVote). It is marked hasVoted, so it is final and cannot be changed.
No tokens, ETH or approvals move. The Ballot has no nonce and no deadline, so any relayer can submit the signature at any time while the proposal's vote is open.
formats.shown: "Cast vote on Hop governance proposal", with the proposal id as a raw number and the vote as Against, For or Abstain from an enum that matches the contract's VoteType.

findings.title: Ballot: the proposal id is a hash; the raw value does not show what the proposal does.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json field {path: proposalId, format: raw}. In OZ Governor.sol, proposalId = hashProposal(targets, values, calldatas, descriptionHash), a 256-bit hash. The Ballot message does not carry the proposal's content.
findings.fix: None possible in ERC-7730. The signer must check the id against Tally or another off-chain source.

findings.title: Ballot: the vote weight and the fact that the vote is final are not on the screen.
findings.evidence: Governor.sol _castVote: weight = getVotes(account, proposal.voteStart.getDeadline()). GovernorCountingSimple._countVote: require(!proposalvote.hasVoted[account]) followed by hasVoted = true.
findings.fix: The weight lives in storage, so no field can show it. A wallet could add a note that a cast vote cannot be changed.

findings.title: Ballot: the intent does not include the chosen vote; an interpolatedIntent could.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json has intent "Cast vote on Hop governance proposal" and no interpolatedIntent. The vote direction appears only in the 'Vote' field.

findings.title: Ballot: the test cases use proposalId 128, not a real proposal hash.
findings.evidence: cases/0-2 have message.proposalId = 128. Real OZ Governor ids are keccak hashes of 77 decimal digits, so the tests do not show how a real id renders.
findings.fix: Use a real Hop proposal id in at least one test case.
